resources.string: Today tasks or schedule at a glance
Combined tasks, schedule, and mini calendar
Long-press your home screen → Widgets → SchedMate. Choose 2×2 or 2×3, then pick tasks, schedule, or combined view.
See today\'s tasks and schedule at a glance — right from your home screen.
Pick the layout that fits your home screen.
Your launcher doesn\'t support one-tap pinning. Follow these steps:
Long-press an empty area on your home screen
Find \"SchedMate\" and drag a widget to your home screen
Choose tasks, schedule, or combined view when prompted
Long-press your home screen → Widgets → SchedMate
